description.value: Radish is a neighbourhood restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano/False Creek corridor serving fresh, made-from-scratch dishes across lunch, happy hour, dinner, and weekend brunch. The daytime menu leans casual—rice bowls, artisan sandwiches, and salads—while evenings shift to wood-fired pizzettas, house-made pastas, and craft cocktails. An online ordering option makes it straightforward for cyclists to grab a takeout meal without waiting for table service.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands at 40m; stands at 54m; stands at 55m; stands at 60m; stands at 64m; wave at 85m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully active with detailed menus, a live 'Order Now' button, and group booking info, confirming the business is operating. Multiple menu items are marked (v) and (gf) across all menus, confirming vegetarian and gluten-free options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 11:00-17:00; Sa-Su 10:00-17:00) are significantly truncated—website shows evening service until 9:45pm daily. OSM hours should be updated.
A pickup promo code listed as 'valid until January 31st, 2025' is expired, suggesting the homepage has not been fully refreshed recently, though core content appears current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service restaurant on a key Vancouver cycling corridor (West 1st Ave / False Creek route) with takeout, strong vegetarian and GF menu options, and group catering—good utility for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menus extensively label items with (v) for vegetarian and (gf) for gluten-free across lunch, dinner, and happy hour—e.g., Quinoa Bowl (v)(gf), Cashew Kale Caesar (v)(gf), Roasted Mushroom Sandwich (v), Harvest Salad (v)(gf)
